baseline.method: Pinned git source copied before v6 edits; actual-index DOM helper for paths and markup, plus source review.

measurement_convention.activation: One actual button or summary activation. Field focus, keystrokes, keyboard dismissal and native select/date picker internals are excluded and stated separately.
measurement_convention.tap_limit: These are exact semantic control activations for the stated paths, not physical-phone tap or scroll measurements.
measurement_convention.summary_limit: Native details toggling is not implemented by the helper; the real summary activation is counted and open is then set explicitly.
measurement_convention.scroll: Not measured. No browser, screenshots or alternate renderer used.

global_states.name: bootstrap_loading
global_states.meaning: Visible loading message before the synchronous scripts render the entry.

global_states.name: render_error_recovery
global_states.meaning: Try again / Go Home fallback; no invented provider result.

global_states.name: locked_or_closed_guard
global_states.meaning: Protected routes redirect to signin or account records.

global_states.name: payment_pending
global_states.meaning: Outgoing money is held, incoming money is unavailable, and checking never invents confirmation.

global_states.name: reduced_motion
global_states.meaning: Same figures and actions without decorative movement; not browser-verified.
